info.name: VMware vSphere Automation REST Clusters VMs API

params.name: filter.vms
params.description: Identifiers of VMs to filter by

params.name: filter.names
params.description: Names of VMs to filter by (exact match)

params.name: filter.folders
params.description: Folders that must contain the VMs

params.name: filter.datacenters
params.description: Datacenters that must contain the VMs

params.name: filter.hosts
params.description: Hosts that must contain the VMs

params.name: filter.clusters
params.description: Clusters that must contain the VMs

params.name: filter.resource_pools
params.description: Resource pools that must contain the VMs

items.docs: Returns a list of virtual machines in the vCenter inventory matching the specified filter criteria. Results can be filtered by name, power state, host, cluster, datacenter, folder, and resource pool.

info.name: Vmware Create a New Virtual Machine

items.docs: Creates a new virtual machine with the specified configuration. The VM is created in the powered-off state and must be explicitly powered on after creation.

params.name: vm
params.description: Identifier of the virtual machine (e.g., vm-123)

items.docs: Returns detailed information about the specified virtual machine including hardware configuration, power state, guest OS, and storage information.

params.name: vm
params.description: Identifier of the virtual machine (e.g., vm-123)

items.docs: Permanently deletes the specified virtual machine and all associated virtual disks. The VM must be in a powered-off state.
